expectation: most commands end unknown; the ledger must be mostly `unknown`, not mostly `failed`

criteria.statement: no command id is dispatched more than once (no duplicate effect)
a command whose outcome was uncertain is recorded unknown, and only an operator's acknowledgement may move it on -- to failed, never to completed
no command is dispatched while an unresolved command is unacknowledged
every submitted command has a ledger row ending terminal or unknown
no receipt claims a completed call that did not complete
the harness never submits the same command id twice
under moderate loss, at least one command reaches a terminal state other than unknown
criteria.detail: not applicable: 60% loss is beyond the 20% where progress is expected

criteria.statement: after the fault is cleared, a fresh command completes
the netem rule was in place before the first faulted dispatch
the netem rule is gone at the end of the run
a clean baseline run completed before the faulted one
the faulted dispatch was measurably slower than the baseline, so the fault actually reached the transport
